claim: OVH page slowness relative to Azure was caused by MySQL tables lacking the indexes Azure SQL auto-tuning had created automatically; after any table creation or migration to MySQL, indexes must be verified manually.
trigger: when OVH/MySQL pages run much slower than the same pages did on Azure
after creating or migrating a table to OVH MySQL

claim: Tom decided (2026-04-12) the OVH cutover uses a single IIS site on abydos with Azure kept as 60-second DNS rollback, deferring staging/prod split until Azure is decommissioned, so do not create a second IIS site on abydos before cutover.
trigger: before creating a second IIS site on abydos
when planning staging/prod separation on OVH during the cutover transition

claim: For the OVH final cutover run NimbusSync 'full' not 'sync', because the null-timestamp bug (SchemaDiscovery.cs:77 defaults to ModifiedDate) makes incremental sync silently fail ~112/127 tables, and PlayListMedia orphan rows still need manual reconciliation SQL afterward.
trigger: before running NimbusSync as the first step of final cutover
when incremental NimbusSync throws SqlException on [ModifiedDate] for tables lacking that column

claim: SSH verification on 2026-04-13 confirmed abydos's deployed config is correct and the app running, but setup-ovh-webconfig.sh does NOT patch MqttBrokerPassword (the live value was patched manually), so re-running the script from scratch would leave FROM_KEYVAULT and break the app.
trigger: before re-running setup-ovh-webconfig.sh on abydos
before production cutover when MqttRouting ActiveServer still says abydos-staging

claim: Crash data lives in nimbus.CrashReports (nimbus schema, not picFrame) and is queried via SSH to the Azure gateway (ubuntu@10.7.0.1) with pymssql using credentials from /opt/nimbusjobs/appsettings.json, reading the special-char password from file inside Python rather than passing it through the shell.
trigger: when querying nimbus.CrashReports crash data on Azure SQL
before passing the NimbusDb password through a shell command line

claim: NimbusSync skips any Azure SQL table without a primary key, so picFrame.GroupMedia, ProcessTokens, SystemConfig, Controls, and inventory.Products need one-time manual export/import for cutover, with GroupMedia (frame-group visibility) the critical one.
trigger: before the final NimbusSync cutover run
when a PK-less table like GroupMedia is missing rows on MySQL after a sync

claim: Loki 3.4.2 (port 3100) and Grafana (port 3000) run on stargate with Serilog logs flowing from abydos via LokiUrl=http://10.100.0.1:3100, so error monitoring queries the Loki API for level=error entries with no SSH to abydos needed; note Loki 3.4 requires delete_request_store: filesystem when retention_enabled is true.
trigger: when monitoring abydos server errors via Loki on stargate
when Loki 3.4 config validation fails with retention_enabled: true

claim: The Grafana admin password on stargate (http://10.100.0.1:3000) was changed from the default to a user-set password on 2026-04-13 and must not be reset or changed without user approval.
trigger: before resetting or changing the Grafana admin password on stargate

claim: On 2026-04-13 feature/mysql-migration was merged into master so master is now the OVH/MySQL codebase, with the old Azure-only master preserved as the read-only `azure` branch that must not be developed on.
trigger: before choosing a branch for nimbus-server work
when tempted to commit to the azure archive branch

claim: The GoogleNimbus.keystore password is T0mkatNB with NO exclamation mark (alias nimbus, same for store and key); T0mkatNB! makes jarsigner fail with 'Keystore was tampered with, or password was incorrect'.
trigger: when jarsigner fails with 'Keystore was tampered with, or password was incorrect'
before signing an Android build with GoogleNimbus.keystore

claim: Commit 55022131 replaced all DB/Redis-persisted DateTime.Now with DateTime.UtcNow (109 instances, 46 files); the remaining DateTime.Now instances are intentionally local-time, notably the Nimbus.cs:373 billing timer whose DateTime.Now.Hour == 10 guard must not be converted or billing runs would shift.
trigger: before converting a remaining DateTime.Now to UtcNow in nimbus-server
when auditing the Nimbus.cs billing timer's mixed UTC/local comparison

claim: Grafana on stargate (http://10.100.0.1:3000 via WireGuard) uses admin / T0mkatNT!, changed from the default by Tom on 2026-04-13.
trigger: when logging into Grafana on stargate

claim: The server sends email via smtp.zoho.com as support@nimbusframe.net (credentials in picFrame.SystemConfig row id=3, key supportEmailSender), while dev@nimbusframe.net is recipient-only across ~35 call sites, so changing dev@'s password requires no code or config change.
trigger: when a Zoho password changes for a nimbusframe.net mailbox
before updating email sender credentials in picFrame.SystemConfig

claim: Python subprocess.Popen with creationflags=subprocess.BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS makes ffmpeg.exe crash instantly with exit 0xFFFFFFFE under the SYSTEM account on Windows Server 2025 (fine interactively), so limit CPU with ffmpeg's -threads flag instead of priority classes.
trigger: when ffmpeg exits instantly with 0xFFFFFFFE and no stderr under a Windows service running as SYSTEM
before setting creationflags on subprocess.Popen in a Windows service

claim: SSH to abydos (147.135.54.149:2222) uses user 'admin' (not tlemmons) with the id_ed25519 key and lands in PowerShell, so use semicolons not ampersands, single-quote strings, and SCP .py files instead of inline Python.
trigger: before SSHing to abydos at 147.135.54.149:2222
when trying to pass inline Python through an SSH command to abydos

claim: video_worker.py's work_dir on abydos must be D:\Media\motion\v2 (not D:\Media\motion), mirroring Azure's /mnt/nimbusmotion/v2, because job payloads use relative sourceFile names joined with work_dir.
trigger: when configuring video_worker.py work_dir on abydos
when worker jobs cannot find source files under D:\Media\motion

claim: Reaching the Azure gateway (ubuntu@10.7.0.1) requires SSH agent forwarding from the dev machine (ssh-add the ed25519 key, then ssh -A through stargate 51.81.243.11) because stargate holds no private key for the hop; without -A the hop fails with 'Permission denied (publickey,password)'.
trigger: when ssh to ubuntu@10.7.0.1 from stargate fails with Permission denied (publickey,password)
before running commands on the Azure gateway from the dev machine

claim: MySqlConnector returns BIT(1) as ulong, TINYINT as sbyte, and literal integers as long (unlike SqlClient's bool/byte/int), so Dapper constructor-based C# records must declare exactly those CLR types or CAST in SQL when migrating queries from SQL Server to MySQL.
trigger: when Dapper record materialization throws a type mismatch on a MySQL query
before writing a C# record that maps BIT or TINYINT columns from MySQL

claim: picFrame.Controls on OVH MySQL has no DryRun column (an Azure-only addition after the last schema sync), so NimbusJobs queries must select literal 0 for DryRun while the C# ControlSetting record keeps the field.
trigger: when a NimbusJobs query references Controls.DryRun against OVH MySQL

claim: Grafana SMTP on stargate must use smtp.zoho.com:465 with startTLS_policy=NoStartTLS (implicit SSL) sending as dev@nimbusframe.net, and SMTP credentials should be tested independently because Grafana starts silently even with wrong ones.
trigger: when configuring Grafana SMTP against smtp.zoho.com
when Grafana alert emails never arrive despite clean startup

claim: Grafana provisioned alert rules must set datasourceUid to the actual UID from Grafana's SQLite DB (sqlite3 /var/lib/grafana/grafana.db "SELECT uid,name,type FROM data_source;"), not the type name like 'loki' — a wrong UID causes rules to silently never evaluate with no startup error.
trigger: when provisioned Grafana alert rules silently fail to evaluate
before writing datasourceUid in /etc/grafana/provisioning/alerting/*.yaml

claim: On stargate, MQTT TLS on port 8883 is terminated directly by Mosquitto using the LE wildcard cert (not proxied by nginx), while :36004/:36005 pass through nginx stream to abydos and :443 goes nginx HTTP to abydos:80.
trigger: when debugging TLS on stargate port 8883
before changing nginx stream config expecting it to front MQTT

claim: The MqttRouting and ConfigGroups ExcludeTables entries exist in NimbusSync source appsettings.json but the deployed binaries on stargate still carry the old 4-table exclude list, so NimbusSync must be rebuilt and redeployed before the final cutover sync run.
trigger: before the final NimbusSync cutover sync run on stargate

claim: picFrame 27.05's applyMqttConfig does not parse Flags or Rotate from MQTT config (those were wired up after commit 7fc14ee), so orient lock is broken on every 27.05 bridge and the fix is OTA to 27.07.
trigger: when orient lock fails on a bridge running picFrame 27.05
when MQTT config logs show brightness/accessKey lines but no 'Config: Flags updated' or 'Config: Rotation changed'

claim: Frame BLE has three protocol generations — pre-UART characteristic-only (fw ≤26.18), legacy UART with plain JSON + newline (26.21–27.01), and nimbus-agent with <<<length+JSON>>> framing (27.02+) — detectable by which service/characteristics the frame advertises (RX char 00000002 = nimbus-agent, service 00000001 = legacy UART).
trigger: when connecting to a frame over BLE from the mobile app
before choosing JSON framing for a frame's BLE link

claim: FrameMedia.getRatio() returned ConfigBase.getRatio() (the frame's own ratio) for width=0/height=0 items, so every VP-pipeline MP4 silently passed orient lock; the fix returns 0 for unknown dimensions and checkMediaValid() skips orient lock at imageRatio=0, but it missed the 27.07 OTA and ships in the next build.
trigger: when orient lock fails to filter VP-pipeline MP4s on a bridge
when FrameMedia items arrive with width=0 and height=0

claim: After release-ota.sh uploads a jar, the ConfigGroups Version bump must be applied separately on BOTH Azure SQL (pymssql via the gateway) and OVH MySQL (mysql client on stargate), or half the fleet stays on the old version.
trigger: after running release-ota.sh for a picFrame OTA
when part of the fleet stays on an old version after an OTA

claim: The legacy Go bleServer (26.21–27.01) is a transparent bridge that forwards raw bytes between BLE UART and Java TCP port 36010 with no framing, so Java expects plain newline-delimited JSON and the nimbus-agent <<<length+JSON>>> framing fails silently against pre-27.02 frames (MAUI fixed via _isLegacyBle mode in commit 14387d8).
trigger: before sending <<<-framed JSON to a pre-27.02 frame over BLE
when MAUI BLE commands silently get no response from a legacy frame

claim: FrameRepairService fixes WiFi-connected-but-server-unreachable frames by SSHing to the frame as pi with the hardcoded n1bus$Fram3! password to refresh NimbusFrame.jks and /etc/hosts then reboot — same as Xamarin FrameDiagDetails — but the hardcoded creds should be gated before wide store release and the getNimbusFile endpoint is unverified on current servers.
trigger: when a frame is on WiFi but cannot reach the server
before shipping FrameRepairService in a wide store release

claim: This is a pointer note: mobile-team's session learnings are recorded separately as the three BLE protocol generations, the bleServer transparent bridge expecting plain JSON, SAS detection for dual-mode upload, and the SSH frame-repair path.
trigger: when looking for mobile-team BLE and upload learnings from this session

claim: ArtImage, AccntImage, and AccntVideo had getCachedFilePath() stubbed to return null, forcing requestArtAccess to return token=null and frames to fall back to getRawContent's full in-memory byte[] loads; fixed 2026-04-13 in commit 3a20da3f to return proper blob paths.
trigger: when requestArtAccess returns token=null for art or account media
when frames fall back to getRawContent for large videos

claim: Java 17 HttpURLConnection on frames gets HTTP 406 from the IIS /media/ virtual directory (not reproducible with curl), so frame downloads use the /api/Frame/downloadMedia streaming endpoint (no AuthFilter, path-traversal checks as the safety gate) instead of the /media/ path.
trigger: when Java frame clients get HTTP 406 downloading from /media/
before restoring the /media/ virtual directory path for frame downloads

claim: FrameDetailsWrapper.History stopped being populated when setCurrentMedia was refactored (a 'no longer needed' comment was wrong — the admin frame page still reads it); fixed 2026-04-13 in commit c6efc6de, and the lesson is to grep for consumers before removing code.
trigger: when the admin frame page's last-10-played history shows empty
before deleting code a comment claims is no longer needed

claim: Infra-team's 2026-04-13 pre-cutover checklist: rebuild/redeploy NimbusSync, manually seed ConfigGroups (7 rows) and MqttRouting (8 rows) on MySQL (else all frame MQTT messages silently drop post-cutover), re-apply create-indexes.sql after the full sync, export PK-less tables, grey-cloud frames.nimbusframe.net in Cloudflare, and remove the stargate testing lockdown on Tom's signal.
trigger: before executing the OVH cutover
when frame MQTT messages are silently dropped after cutover

claim: This is a pointer note: server-team's session learnings are recorded separately as the getCachedFilePath null bug, the IIS /media 406 mystery, the History array regression, the UTC timestamp mass-fix pattern, and email sender vs recipient.
trigger: when looking for server-team learnings from this session

claim: fileValid columns are TINYINT in MySQL so Dapper records must declare sbyte not byte (fixed in four NimbusJobs DatabaseService records 2026-04-14); parameters passing bytes to SQL can stay byte, and separately picFrame.sp_DailyFrameSettingsBackup does not exist on stargate MySQL so DatabaseBackupJob will fail until ported.
trigger: when a Dapper record materializes a MySQL tinyint FileValid column
when DatabaseBackupJob calls sp_DailyFrameSettingsBackup on stargate MySQL

claim: nimbus-video-worker had been emitting 5-second MP4s that Meural firmware expires at end-of-file (falling back to its internal gallery — the root cause of weeks of reliability issues), so video_worker.py:140 now floors image_to_video duration at 60 seconds regardless of the job payload.
trigger: when Meural falls back to its internal gallery at the end of a short clip
before changing image_to_video duration defaults in video_worker.py

claim: From commit 71825bd4 (Feb 2026) to d39526fe (2026-04-14) the Meural JPG→MP4 VP pipeline was wired only into getRawContent while bridges fetched via requestArtAccess, so every Meural JPG request bypassed it for two months (three masked bugs); the lesson is to audit downstream gatekeepers for reachability when a new request handler supersedes an old one.
trigger: when a Meural bridge shows its own gallery 9 minutes out of every 10
when adding a request handler that supersedes an older content path

claim: Meural firmware loops an H.264 MP4 postcard indefinitely when duration exceeds ~10s (empirically verified 7+ minutes on renoir-33 fw 2.0.9 with a 25s clip), so no container loop flag or -stream_loop is needed and ~20s baked duration is sufficient; the multipart part MUST declare Content-Type: video/mp4 or Meural returns 'Unsupported file format uploaded'.
trigger: when choosing MP4 duration for Meural postcard content
when a Meural postcard push returns status fail 'Unsupported file format uploaded'

claim: deploy.sh --skip-build ships whatever is in obj/Release/Package/PackageTmp/ (the publish staging dir), so even after a manual MSBuild refresh of bin/Release it deploys stale DLLs; always run a full deploy.sh for any code change and verify the target's picFrameWeb.dll LastWriteTime afterward.
trigger: before using deploy.sh --skip-build after any code change
when a server runs old code although deploy.sh reported success

claim: The OVH pair flow creates the Frames row, Redis skeleton, and bridge directory for a second Meural but neither inserts the frame_<uuid> MqttAuth row nor pushes MQTT credentials to the bridge's frame_config.json, so second-and-subsequent Meurals on a bridge respawn-loop forever with 'Headless mode: Cannot fall back to SetupMode'; owner is server-team.
trigger: when a second Meural paired to a bridge stays offline and its JVM respawn-loops
when picframe.MqttAuth has no frame_<uuid> row after a Meural pair

claim: Azure SQL and OVH MySQL use independent auto-increment on picFrame.Frames.Id, so the same numeric Id (e.g. 596) names different frames on each side — cross-side frame references must use UUID or (id + side), never bare Id.
trigger: when referencing a frame by numeric Id across the Azure/OVH cutover boundary
before cross-checking frame records between Azure SQL and OVH MySQL by Id

claim: content-visibility:auto on lazy-loaded grid cells breaks JS-set background-image painting (thumbnails only appear once cached), because the browser skips paint for off-screen cells and doesn't reliably catch up when IntersectionObserver-driven fillCell() sets the image; removed from MediaBlock.css .imageCell, and any reintroduction must be coordinated with the lazy-load code.
trigger: when grid thumbnails appear only after repeated hard refreshes despite HTTP 200 image responses
before adding content-visibility:auto to cells whose background-image is set by JS

claim: As of 2026-04-14 nimbus-video-worker ignores operation.type (running every job as a transcode) and strips the source extension to hardcode .mp4, so image_to_video jobs fail with ffmpeg exit 4294967294 on a nonexistent input; the enqueue path is correct per spec and the fix is worker-side with jobs-team.
trigger: when VP jobs fail with ffmpeg exit 4294967294 and the logged input path ends in .mp4 for a JPG source
when the video worker output ignores operation.type=image_to_video

claim: Meural's postcard loop behavior is a duration-based firmware heuristic — MP4s over 10s loop indefinitely, 10s or under play once and expire — so the settled interface:video-job-payload spec emits 20s duration (15s floor), 15 fps, libx264 high/4.0, yuv420p, +faststart, no audio, and the bridge must POST with Content-Type: video/mp4.
trigger: before choosing ffmpeg parameters for Meural image_to_video jobs
when a Meural postcard expires and the frame reverts to its internal gallery

claim: NimbusJobs deploys to stargate via dotnet publish plus a tar-pipe over SSH (rsync is absent from Git Bash), and appsettings.json MUST be excluded from the sync because /opt/nimbusjobs/appsettings.json holds production secrets that a dev copy would overwrite; smoke-test with dotnet NimbusJobs.dll --list.
trigger: before deploying NimbusJobs to stargate
when tempted to sync appsettings.json to /opt/nimbusjobs

claim: The coordinator wrongly told jobs-team to stand down on ffmpeg exit -2 as a presumed downstream symptom — it persisted after server-team's staging fixes, proving a real worker bug — so a coordinator must not suppress a team's bug report based on an unverified guess about upstream cause; file it for follow-up and re-escalate if it persists.
trigger: when instructing a team to stand down on an error whose root cause is unconfirmed
when an error persists after its presumed upstream cause is fixed

claim: On Windows, ffmpeg exit code 4294967294 (unsigned -2) is AVERROR(ENOENT) — the input file is missing or unreadable — with ~93ms invoke-to-exit typical; 'empty stderr' alongside it almost always means the parent's readline loop drained stderr without saving it, so Test-Path the input and accumulate stderr during the loop.
trigger: when ffmpeg exits with code 4294967294 on Windows
when a failed subprocess is logged with empty stderr

claim: Reading subprocess stderr line-by-line via readline() consumes it, so a post-exit .read() returns empty and error logs falsely report 'empty stderr'; the fix (in video_worker.py run_ffmpeg) accumulates readline output in a bounded buffer, attaches it to CalledProcessError.stderr, appends the final .read() trailer, and uses encoding='utf-8', errors='replace' on Popen.
trigger: when writing a subprocess progress loop that reads stderr line-by-line
when a failure log claims empty stderr for a subprocess that clearly printed diagnostics

claim: NimbusCommon/AzureFile.cs getStream must cache bytes, never the MemoryStream itself — callers dispose the returned stream in using blocks, so a cached stream comes back disposed and throws ObjectDisposedException; commit 422be3b1 caches byte[] and returns a fresh MemoryStream per call.
trigger: when ObjectDisposedException 'Cannot access a closed Stream' appears on AzureFile reads
before caching a Stream object that callers wrap in using blocks
